title: The Euler line
intro: Every triangle has a circumcentre O (the centre of the circle through its vertices), a centroid G (where the medians meet), an orthocentre H (where the altitudes meet) and a nine-point centre N. Euler found in 1767 that O, G and H always lie on one line, with G one third of the way from O to H. Drag the vertex C and watch the line move.
